dedupe_keys.name: effects brought by the hit2gap solution in all four pilot sites results evaluation and overall evaluation of the hit2gap solution

description: EDELL-HARPER Amelina and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed evaluation examines integration and operation of the HIT2GAP solution at four pilot sites. It documents testing methodology, pilot-manager feedback and operational lessons, including the difference between simulated and measured building energy. Supporting deployment and lessons-learned reports describe the same evaluation programme. The abstract gives no numerical savings and does not establish that all modules perform equally at every site. This case supports assessment of actual deployment and model-to-measurement performance gaps, with individual data and algorithms catalogued separately. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
